# toWidthDistribution

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`WidthDistributionInput`](width-distribution-input.md) to the [`WidthDistribution`](width-distribution.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toWidthDistribution(input: WidthDistributionToken | WidthDistribution): WidthDistribution
```
